steps.promotion_criteria: Direct recruitment through MPESB Police Sub-Inspector Examination (Prelims, Mains, Physical Proficiency Test and Interview), followed by 1-year basic institutional training at MP Police Academy (MPPA) Bhauri, Bhopal.

steps.designation: Inspector of Police (TI / Circle Inspector / Subedar Major)
steps.promotion_criteria: Promotion on merit-cum-seniority basis after 6 to 8 years of gazetted investigation service as SI, passing mandatory departmental law examinations, and possessing unblemished ACR gradings.
steps.source_label: Madhya Pradesh Police Executive (Gazetted/Non-Gazetted) Service Rules

steps.designation: Deputy Superintendent of Police (DSP / Assistant Commissioner of Police)
steps.promotion_criteria: Promotion into State Police Service (Gazetted Class I) through MPPSC Departmental Promotion Committee after 6 to 10 years of service as Inspector.

steps.designation: Additional Superintendent of Police (Addl. SP / Additional DCP)
steps.promotion_criteria: Seniority-cum-merit promotion from DSP rank after 5 to 7 years in senior executive policing assignments.

steps.designation: Superintendent of Police (SP / SSP / IPS Induction)
steps.promotion_criteria: Induction into Indian Police Service (IPS) via state promotion quota under Union Public Service Commission (UPSC) and Ministry of Home Affairs regulations.
